findings.label: highlights hydration dependency drift
findings.detail: The useEffect in TripForm uses [defaultValues?.title] as its sole dependency. If server data updates the highlights but the title remains the same (edge case during concurrent edits), the form won't re-hydrate. Include defaultValues?.highlights or use JSON.stringify(defaultValues) in the dependency array.

findings.label: No backend seat-update logic for seatsByStartDate
findings.detail: The schema adds seatsByStartDate and the frontend reads from it, but the diff does not show backend logic to increment/decrement seats in the per-date array when a booking is created. Verify that createBooking() updates the specific date's seat count in seatsByStartDate, not just the global availableSeats.
